draft: Proposal draft. Rewritten in everyday English, not a word-for-word translation of the Korean. App name and the five step names come from i18n/en.json 3.3.4-en. Nothing in this file is approved yet.

strings.metaTitle: 100 is just the display range, not a top score.
strings.ask: What's on your mind right now?
strings.askPh: Write it however it comes. One line is fine.
strings.start: Before we jump to answers, want to talk a little about where this thought came from?
strings.startNow: I'd rather hear an answer first
strings.nowNote: This prototype isn't connected to an AI, so it can't give you an answer. In the real app, you could get one right here.
strings.demoNote: This is a demo question. In the real app, the next question follows what you say.
follow: When do you feel that the most?
In that moment, what bothers you most?
What matters most to you in that moment?
Has something like this happened before?
strings.fEnd: Want to pull together what we've talked about? You can keep writing if you like.
strings.sumTitle: Does any of these questions stick with you?
strings.cand1: What were you trying hardest to protect in that moment?
strings.cand2: How much does other people's opinion of you matter right now?
strings.candEdit: Feel free to rewrite it. It's better in your own words.
strings.candNote: These are just examples. They don't tell you the cause.
strings.keepTalking: I want to talk a bit more
strings.confirmQ: Does this question really speak to you right now? Or is a different one coming to mind?
strings.cOther: A different one's coming to mind
strings.cNone: No question really speaks to me yet
strings.done: Meta-view +3. A new connection just formed.
strings.doneNext: Start your five-step map with this question.
strings.rest: Some days your thoughts just won't untangle. You don't have to find the answer here. Doing something else for a while might help them settle.
strings.restActsNote: Things like these can help your thoughts find their flow.
strings.unsure: That's okay. You can stop here without deciding.
strings.stopped: Paused. You can pick it up anytime.
strings.safety: This prototype isn't a medical or counselling service. If you're in danger or need help urgently, call your local emergency number.
strings.fine: No AI connected (demo questions) · Nothing is saved or sent · Sound plays only if you turn it on, and is made on this screen
strings.legendA: Teal dashes = approved copy (Korean only so far)
